column1: # Ultimate food sets for T14, taken from the authors' own deposited code, not typed from memory.
# Biochemical: `input_food_list` in FromSelectedFoodSet_to_LinProg_KEGG.py inside S2 Python Script
#   (journal.pcbi.1010498.s028.zip), the script that produced S11 Table. Comments are the authors' own.
#   It lists the paper's nine food species plus six ion/hydrate forms. Paper text (PMC9491600, Sect. 2.3), verbatim:
#   "we chose {H2, CH4, NO, FeS2, visible light} and {H2O,CO2,NH3,H2S,H2SO4,H2SO3,HSO3−,H3PO4,H4P2O7} as the ultimate food, respectively."
#   The nine-species file Biochem_ufs.txt (S3 Python Script, journal.pcbi.1010498.s029.zip) gives the same
#   tier-0 system; the gate checks both against S10 Table (30 species, 44 reactions).
# Abiotic: `input_food_list` in FromSelectedFoodSet_to_LinProg_Adam.py (same zip), identical to Abiotic_ufs.txt.
